visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a mountain road with a silver guardrail. A concrete wall and all surrounding vegetation are heavily covered in white frost or rime ice. Several people in winter attire are walking along the road. In the background, a massive mountain peak is partially shrouded in thick white fog and clouds under a bright sky. (2) The camera moves to showcase a dense forest of evergreen trees, each one completely white with ice crystals. The sky is a vibrant blue with scattered white clouds, providing a stark contrast to the white landscape. (3) A sweeping pan reveals a deep valley and rolling mountain ridges. Some slopes show brown and green vegetation, while others are entirely white with frost. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows across the topography. (4) The scene shifts to a roadside parking or observation area. A white car is parked, and a man in a black jacket is seen standing by the open trunk. The foreground bushes are thick with ice. (5) Final panoramic views capture the distant mountain peaks and the high-altitude road winding through the frosted terrain. The camera movement is handheld and steady, capturing the vastness of the alpine environment.
